installer_policy.reason: In the union of the open JevBench board's top 10 by Capability Score (#10) but not yet tested end to end: the author's recipe needs Docker with the NVIDIA container runtime and a >=64 GB GPU, and the rented pod types available to this job (RunPod/Lium containers) cannot run Docker. Local install is available on request until a Docker-capable GPU host has run the full install, self-test and uninstall.

readout.notes: Author bundle (serving/xor-26b-a4b-1.0-serving.tar.gz) runs SGLang in the author Docker image (prakhar1611/xor-sglang) with xn_base_server.py (sha256 624242a7...) exposing /v1/systemone; choice temperature 1.95, noul/score 1.0 from XN_TEMP_JSON. SGLang plus a custom server; not backend-agnostic.
readout.portable_notes: No portable author variant verified. The pinned release documents serving/xor-26b-a4b-1.0-serving.tar.gz and the BH recipe launches its SGLang engine with a logprob scheduler patch and selected-token readout. No unmodified CPU/MPS device selector or same-author MLX/GGUF readout was found. https://huggingface.co/juspay/Xor-26B-A4B/raw/8afd4396492084c7c91846ed3791161d54665d34/README.md . BF16 weights are 51.612 GB even though only 4B parameters are active; memory is determined by total parameters. backend_agnostic=false. Read-only official archive inspection: xn_base_server.py L148–150 calls SGLang /generate with return_logprob, logprob_start_len=-1 and token_ids_logprob; release uses a patched SGLang image, not a generic logprobs endpoint. Archive SHA256 9fd6043f1cfc9ba15b37b895d7893f4c113e686d1f4c2a70d1cd74437fcbaec7.

variants.runtime: sglang (author Docker image, pinned by digest)

steps: hf download juspay/Xor-26B-A4B @ 8afd4396 (~51.6 GB) and docker pull the pinned image (~14.8 GB compressed).
Verify serving/xor-26b-a4b-1.0-serving.tar.gz against its sha256 (9fd6043f...); extract and check xn_base_server.py (624242a7...).
Write the author .env (MODEL_DIR, API_PORT=30002, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, TP_SIZE=1, DP_SIZE=1, CONTEXT_LENGTH=131072, MEM_FRACTION_STATIC=0.80), then the author run.sh; stop with stop.sh.
Adapter: jevbench typesafe, endpoint http://127.0.0.1:30002, model xor-26b-a4b-1.0, timeout 900 s.

measured.gpu: UNVERIFIED for the v1.6 row; the intake recipe names RTX PRO 6000 96GB (VERDICT)

variants.expected_speed: About 59 ms p 50 per decision (raw, serial) on the BH measurement; GPU UNVERIFIED. Provisioning class: RTX PRO 6000 96 GB; this names a memory class, not a latency measurement or confirmation of architecture compatibility. CPU/Mac speed is estimated only in separate portable variants.
variants.notes: min_vram_gb 64 is the intake VERDICT (">=64GB"; ~49 GB weights plus KV at mem-fraction 0.80). The NVFP4 sibling juspay/Xor-26B-A4B-NVFP4 was measured in run 46 under a different key and needs Blackwell; it is not part of this entry. Bundle and image are third-party: the installer must verify digests before use. Host RAM provisioning estimate: pinned weight files sum to 51.612 GB; ×1.25 loader/runtime allowance rounded up to 4 GB gives 68 GB. This is not a measured peak; FP32 initialization or duplicate weight buffers may require more.
